chunks: A group, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Suleyman Al-Ja'fari who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'Recite the Adhan in your house, for it repels the Satan, and it is recommended for the sake of the children.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of reciting the Adhan in the home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual efficacy of the Adhan as a protective measure against Satan, extending its merit beyond the mosque to the domestic sphere. Notably, it emphasizes the pedagogical value of this practice for children, encouraging their early familiarity with the call to prayer to foster religious habituation. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on integrating worship into daily family life to cultivate spiritual awareness from a young age.
